source: User correction 2026-10-16: z^E is the determined future reference value; theory determines implementation, not code behavior.
decision: Treat z^E from the true future measured window as a target/reference in the joint loss. The z^E target branch is not optimized by the z-loss gradient; only the predictive branch is updated by that term.
rule: Theory defines the objective before implementation details.
z^E is computed from true future measured data and serves as the reference encoded lifted state.
z^P is the recursively predicted lifted state compared against z^E.
Do not describe this as a new teacher mechanism or add defensive explanation in the manuscript.
Deployment still encodes only the initial history and recursively propagates z.
boundary: This does not make the empirical loss prove A3.
No stability, observability, generalization, or closed-loop guarantee is added.
